transcript: Mard, 40 saal. Kal raat se dast lalki hai. 8 mahada lena phoolna hai. Jism par daane ek mahina. HB 10. Cefixime 200 ek goliin. HB 10. Doveraston ek goli arse aath ghante raat. Gliclazac 400 din. Metinem baad, 5 din. Doodh aur tali ho, check up. Veshab kam. HB 14. Novorapid 500 aadhi goli haro.
